reason: B proposes the more physically grounded and testable advance: explicit force-constant disorder and anharmonic phonon lifetimes, independent electronic estimation, phonon-scattering measurements, and a falsifiable prediction of weak 300–1200 K lattice-conductivity dependence. Its cited support is partly generic and it inadequately specifies the required low-temperature comparison, but A relies on less credible channel-isolation methods and unsupported accuracy claims.
